hits.video_tip: Turn a finished 40K short into an event: cut a 15-20s trailer, end on a card asking "Which chapter should I make next?" and point people to a poll. Native video beats the static poster he used.
hits.operator_draft:
Want to decide what the next Warhammer 40K short is about? Your vote picks it.

Three chapters are on the table: Space Wolves, Adepta Sororitas or the Noise Marines. Vote in the poll and the winner gets the full Seedance treatment as my next 40K AI short.

[attach: 15s teaser + poll]

outsiders.text:
Today, we’re excited to share Enact, a research preview of scenes that respond to you.

Enact represents a new way of making AI video, one that’s designed to mimic the experience of directing on set. Built on Pika H3 Flex, it allows a creator to interact with “actors,” manually https://t.co/cQVL914PRu

Today, we’re excited to share Enact, a research preview of scenes that respond to you.

The pitch is AI video that feels like being the director on set. It runs on Pika H3 Flex, and you get to work with the AI actors yourself.

outsiders.name: Higgsfield AI 🧩
outsiders.text:
Stop prompting emotions.

This AI commercial explores five emotions. We didn't prompt any of them.

Instead, we focused on:

> Physical details
> Camera direction
> Character motivation

Here’s how we did it 🧵 https://t.co/VaG4GhppFj
outsiders.original_en:
Stop prompting emotions.

This AI commercial explores five emotions. We didn't prompt any of them.

Instead, we focused on:

> Physical details
> Camera direction
> Character motivation

Here’s how we did it 🧵 https://t.co/VaG4GhppFj
outsiders.hook: 'Stop prompting emotions' thread: a 5-emotion AI commercial built from physical details, camera direction and character motivation instead of emotion words - 30.3K views, 371 bookmarks (best save rate in the lane).
outsiders.video_tip: Make one Seedance 40K close-up where you never write 'angry' or 'afraid' - only gauntlet grip, breath fog, a slow push-in - and post the prompt as the lesson.
outsiders.draft_en:
Writing emotions into your prompt is the wrong move.

Higgsfield made an AI commercial built around five emotions, and none of them were named in a prompt. The work went into character motivation, where the camera goes and small physical details.

The full breakdown is in their thread - worth it for anyone making AI video.

outsiders.text:

outsiders.original_en:
“ The future of AI filmmaking is becoming more interactive. 🎬

Enact by Pika is redefining storytelling, giving creators real-time control over actors, scenes, and camera movements. A fascinating step toward making AI video feel more like directing a real production.

AI filmmaking is turning interactive.

With Pika Enact you steer the actors, the scene and the camera live, as it plays. That pushes AI video a lot closer to running an actual production.

Try Pika Enact here:

x_keywords.method: Read-only x MCP search_posts_all, 2 calls per keyword: last 24 h and previous 24 h (24-48 h ago); lang:en, no retweets/replies, sort=relevancy, up to 25 posts per window. This is a SAMPLE of top-relevance posts, not every post on X. Views = impression_count at fetch time. Rank = sum of sampled 24 h views; 48 h = both windows; trend = 24 h sum / previous 24 h sum (up >=1.3, down <=0.7). Fresh posts are still gaining views, so 'up' is understated. Top-post share > 70% means one viral post carries the keyword.

Missing data shows as 'no data'. Heat = sum log10(views) of topic posts (24 h x1, 24-48 h x0.5), scaled to 100. Momentum = log-views last 24 h / previous 24 h. Trend-input-only accounts feed the corpus but are never shown as hits.
